methodology.gold_annotations: Existing ontology URIs and provisional mappings are carried over from prior curated tests; implicit entity gold is intentionally unset.
methodology.execution: Use same ontology index, run context, model and candidate universe across retrieval methods.
limitations: Not a held-out dataset; overlaps earlier curated questions and known mappings.
Some explicit-function mappings may not have samples in the selected run.
Implicit questions need independent ontology-based adjudication before scoring.
Single-triple SPARQL cannot perform cross-domain engineering-function resolution.
Run ID and bounds must be authoritative; no LLM-created SQL or SPARQL execution without validation.
